name: camayoc_deployments_by_day
description: delivery-and-dora Q1: deployments per service and outcome on one UTC day, from aegis:DeploymentEvent records in the deployment window graphs. Its acceptance is reproducing an independent deploy-log count exactly. occurredAt is matched by its RFC 3339 date prefix, so producers must emit UTC (Z) times for the day boundary to be exact.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?service ?outcome (COUNT(DISTINCT ?event) AS ?deployments) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?event a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deployedService ?service ; aegis:deploymentOutcome ?outcome ; aegis:occurredAt ?at . } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?at), "{day}")) } GROUP BY ?service ?outcome ORDER BY ?service ?outcome
